name: Hazoret
description: Hazoret is the jackal-headed god of zeal of Amonkhet, the only one of the plane's original gods to survive the Hour of Devastation.

description_citations.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Hazoret is the jackal-headed god of zeal of Amonkhet, the only one of the plane's original gods to survive the Hour of Devastation.

citations.text: "Hazoret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Hazoret presided over the Trial of Zeal, and when Samut pleaded for Djeru's life she cursed Samut, had her seized as a dissenter, and began the final Trial before Gideon blocked her spear.

citations.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

bio.text: During the Hour of Devastation Bolas appeared as the God-Pharaoh, and Bontu, who had secretly served him, attacked Hazoret at his command, then dragged her before him before Bolas killed Bontu.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Hazoret was left the last pillar of Amonkhet, fought the Scorpion God and lost an arm, and led the survivors of Naktamun into the desert as the God-Survivor.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.
"Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She lent her spear to Karn's group against Bolas, and the spear was later used to strike Bolas on Ravnica.

citations.text: "Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Bolas's Citadel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: With the survivors she reclaimed Naktamun, raised the Hekma again and began rebuilding.

citations.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When the Phyrexians invaded Amonkhet she ignited the glistening oil in their veins while Djeru's fighters dismembered them, and she then led survivors in search of more of her kin.

citations.text: "Hazoret", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Hazoret", section "Scouring the Broken Lands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Hazoret is alive and still protecting the survivors of Naktamun, and the latest story shows her leading Samut and Djeru to face an illusion during the Reality Fracture.

citations.text: "Hazoret", section "Scouring the Broken Lands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells initiates that only one will be honored by her spear.
timeline.quote: only one of you will be honored by my spear.

citation.text: Limits of Solidarity (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods, leaving Hazoret, the Scarab God and the Locust God.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's return to the plane during the Hour of Devastation , the majority of the gods were killed.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon shields Djeru from Hazoret, who prophesies that he will die by immortal hands.
timeline.quote: Hazoret prophesied to him that he would die by immortal hands

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret's Trial of Zeal ends with the surviving initiate receiving the most Glorified Death from her forked staff.
timeline.quote: Hazoret granted that initiate the most Glorified Death with her forked staff.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Trial of Zeal, the glorified battle through the Steps of Battle; the first round is a free-for-all marked by the Heart Timer.
timeline.quote: The opening clash is a massive free-for-all

citation.text: "Hazoret's Monument", section "The Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orchestrates duels in the next stage.
timeline.quote: Hazoret commands who faces whom

citation.text: "Hazoret's Monument", section "The Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret pierces the final champion's chest and forehead with her staff and claims their heart.
timeline.quote: she pierces the champion's chest and forehead with her forked staff

citation.text: "Hazoret's Monument", section "The Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kefnet inscribes the deeds of each Trial onto temple walls.
timeline.quote: Kefnet inscribes the deeds of each Trial onto temple walls

citation.text: "Hazoret's Monument", section "The Trial of Zeal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Most of the gods of Amonkhet die when Bolas returns and ushers in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Most of the gods died when Bolas returned and ushered in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret to guide the survivors of Naktamun.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret has Samut imprisoned in a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.
timeline.quote: The god called for Samut to be imprisoned, and she was sealed inside a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut fights beside Djeru in the arena.
timeline.quote: Samut ran to Djeru's side, and the two fought back to back, Samut's only goal being Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut tackles Djeru away from Hazoret's spear and Gideon shields them, denying Djeru his death.
timeline.quote: Gideon intervened at the same moment, protecting the pair of them from Hazoret with his invulnerability.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
timeline.quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
timeline.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut enters Hazoret's monument and requests an audience with the god.
timeline.quote: I request an audience, mighty Hazoret.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
timeline.quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
timeline.quote: Seize the dissenter.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
timeline.quote: Your time has come

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
timeline.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
timeline.quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
timeline.quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
timeline.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
timeline.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, left behind, recalls Hazoret whispering to him that she sees his death and that he is no god.
timeline.quote: for I see your death, Kytheon Iora.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
timeline.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
timeline.quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret if that is paradise, and the god does not answer.
timeline.quote: Is that paradise?

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Luxa drains through the opened Gate as the demon's spell unravels old magics.
timeline.quote: all that remained of the mighty Luxa was a few rivulets of red

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra rallies the stunned gods, and Hazoret is disturbed that Rhonas blasphemed the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: doubt nibbled at the edges of her heart

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
timeline.quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret lets go into her battle frenzy, cutting through mummies, saving a child and burning a hellion.
timeline.quote: Hazoret let go of any shreds of doubt and uncertainty

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
timeline.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
timeline.quote: Who will protect you , Hazoret?

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
timeline.quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh had arrived.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
timeline.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
timeline.quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
timeline.quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
timeline.quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: And Hazoret alone remained, the last pillar of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Hour of Revelation reveals the God-Pharaoh as a malevolent dragon and the survivors flee into the desert.
timeline.quote: the survivors fled into the desert, leaving the destroyed city behind to forge a new destiny

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and the mortals bring the last two corrupted gods away from Naktamun, repopulate the city and create a new Hekma.
timeline.quote: They repopulated the city and created a new Hekma .

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas orders Bontu to kill Hazoret; she defeats her, then Bolas betrays and strikes Bontu down.
timeline.quote: Bolas betrayed Bontu without hesitation and struck her down

citation.text: "Bontu", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bontu exploits Hazoret's compassion and drags her before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Bontu, however, exploited Hazoret's compassion, striking when she was most vulnerable.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays Bontu and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful.
timeline.quote: Instead, Bolas slew Bontu himself

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The living bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk; Hazoret vows to stand by the mortals.
timeline.quote: the living managed to bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Hour of Devastation, Bontu reveals her treachery; Bolas has Bontu bring Hazoret to the God-Pharaoh then kills Bontu, leaving Hazoret the only living god.
timeline.quote: Hazoret now remains the only living god of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret fights the Scorpion God and is severely wounded but weakens its armor so Samut and others can kill it.
timeline.quote: Hazoret managed to weaken its armor enough for Samut and the others to finish it off.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret leads the remaining survivors of Naktamun into the desert, swearing to protect them and becoming the God-Survivor.
timeline.quote: swearing to protect them as long as she drew breath.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Hour of Devastation, Bolas's Eternal army destroys Naktamun and slays most of its gods; the survivors under Hazoret flee.
timeline.quote: the city was destroyed by the Eternal army of Nicol Bolas, and most of its gods were slain

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When the Eternals leave for Ravnica, Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun, raise the Hekma and begin rebuilding.
timeline.quote: Hazoret and the other survivors reclaimed the city

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in the Phyrexians' veins and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Amonkheti declare victory and the Luxa begins to run clear while rebuilding begins.
timeline.quote: the Luxa fouled for so long, and began to flow clear

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas has Bontu killed by the undead after she defeats Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Bolas instead rewarded her with death, forcing numerous undead to tear her apart.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut's spark ignites when she saves Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
timeline.quote: Samut's planeswalker's spark ignited when she saved Hazoret from the Scorpion God

citation.text: "Samut", section "Samut's spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
timeline.quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
timeline.quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
timeline.quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret thanks Samut, and Samut's planeswalker spark ignites; she is carried to another plane and returns to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: she was falling, falling through space, through flashing waves of aether

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes she is a walker between worlds and returns to Amonkhet, then collapses and is caught by Hazoret.
timeline.quote: I am a walker between worlds.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret convinces Dack to return to the battle on Ravnica, and he declines a second chance to escape.
timeline.quote: He was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers visit Hazoret's camp; she tells Dack Fayden to face his destiny and lends her spear against Bolas, which Karn transports to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Hazoret lent her spear as a weapon to take down Bolas

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and the survivors reclaim Naktamun and begin to rebuild.
timeline.quote: Hazoret and the other survivors reclaimed Naktamun, raised the Hekma, and began to rebuild.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn delivers Hazoret's spear to the newly resurrected Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: Karn transported it back to Ravnica and gave it to the newly resurrected Niv-Mizzet .

citation.text: "Karn", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nixilis incinerates the inactive Eternals and, uninterested in Hazoret's fight against Bolas, planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Refusing to go back to the battle on Ravnica, he planeswalked away to safety.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret arrives with Sarkhan and gives them her spear; Samut promises to return to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: At Sarkhan's request, Hazoret gave them her spear to aid them in their fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan helps Hazoret restore the Hekma and she gives a spear to Karn's group against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear to aid them in their fight against Bolas

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn, Ob Nixilis, Dack and Samut defeat Tezzeret on Amonkhet, closing the portal, and meet Hazoret, who gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: On Amonkhet, they defeat Tezzeret , causing the portal to close.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
